## Breaking, read before upgrading

2.0 drops axios for the global fetch (zero runtime dependencies) and requires
**Node 18+**. On Node 16, stay on `easy-currencies@^1`.

| 1.x | 2.x |
| --- | --- |
| `setProxyConfiguration({host, port, auth})` | `setClient(axios.create({ proxy }))`, or any `{ get(url) }` client |
| `throw "Invalid API key!"` | `throw new Error("Invalid API key!")`, check `e.message` |
| `addProvider` / `addMultipleProviders` | `add` / `addMultiple` |
| `Provider.endpoint.multiple` | removed, already unused since 1.x |
| any currency string | must match `/^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}$/` |
| `require("easy-currencies/dist/...")` | blocked, import from the package root |
| no request timeout | 10s default, a slower provider is skipped and the next answers |

Full migration guide: https://github.com/rastenis/easy-currencies/blob/master/MIGRATION.md
